name: plataforma-aberta-suite
description: Suíte desktop local de criação e trabalho
author: Plataforma Aberta

scripts.build: npm run build:editor && npm run prepare:assets
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/require-release.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/require-release.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64 --publish never
